annotations.title: Pre-Sign EVM Hex Calldata Selector Decoder & Drain Simulator

description: Decodes raw EVM hexadecimal transaction calldata (0x...) by 4-byte function selector to expose hidden ERC-20 approve/transferFrom calls, setApprovalForAll drains, and multicall bundles. Use when auditing raw hex transaction data (to, value, data) before broadcasting an on-chain EVM transaction; for inspecting off-chain EIP-712 JSON typed-data signatures, use decode_eip712_permit_signature instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'calldata_hex' ('network' defaults to 'base_mainnet'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

calldata_hex.description: Hexadecimal EVM transaction data string starting with '0x' (e.g. '0x095ea7b3000000000000000000000000...').

network.description: Target EVM network for simulation context; defaults to 'base_mainnet' when omitted.

name: simulate_evm_transaction_calldata

approval_or_drain_risk.description: True if the call grants token/NFT allowances or transfers assets to an untrusted target.

decoded_method.description: Human-readable ABI function signature matched to the selector.
